title: CPTAC LUAD Discovery Study
summary:
Ubiquitylation is the scarcest proteomic modification layer in the NCI portfolio: five studies across the whole Proteomic Data Commons carry it, and this is one of them. On 80 of these 115 lung adenocarcinomas, protein degradation signaling can be measured directly rather than inferred, alongside acetylome and phosphoproteome on all 115.
Because the ubiquitin-proteasome system is a validated therapeutic axis and degradation state is invisible to transcriptomics, this layer answers questions that no expression cohort can. All of it is open and needs no account.
one_liner: 115 lung adenocarcinomas with proteome, phosphoproteome and acetylome, plus ubiquitylome on 80 - one of five ubiquitylation datasets in the Proteomic Data Commons, openly downloadable.

useful_for.question: Which proteins are regulated by degradation rather than by transcription in lung adenocarcinoma?
useful_for.rationale: Ubiquitylome on 80 cases alongside proteome on all 115 allows the two regulatory modes to be separated on the same tumors - the direct test of an assumption that expression studies make implicitly.
useful_for.statistical_note: Ubiquitylation site quantification is sparse; apply a completeness filter and report it, since the filter choice materially changes the feature set.

useful_for.question: How do acetylation and phosphorylation interact in the same tumor?
useful_for.rationale: Both modification layers are measured on all 115 cases, allowing cross-modification analysis on a common set of tumors rather than across separate cohorts.

useful_for.question: Can degradation signatures identify candidate targets for proteasome or E3 ligase directed therapy?
useful_for.rationale: Direct measurement of ubiquitylation state in primary tumors is the substrate for target nomination in a therapeutic area where target selection is usually based on inference.

limitations.statement: Treatment is absent: no therapeutic agent, treatment type or response is recorded for any of the 115 cases, and neither is smoking history, which is central to lung adenocarcinoma biology. Vital status, follow-up time and stage are served by the PDC API even though they do not ship in the study's file bundle.
limitations.mitigation: For smoking history and treatment, retrieve the matching clinical records from the GDC CPTAC-3 record and join on case identifier.

analysis_examples.title: Find and use the scarcest measurements in the portfolio
analysis_examples.question: Where can I find ubiquitylome, lipidome or metabolome data, and which cohorts carry several scarce layers on the same tumors?
analysis_examples.problem: Rare proteomic layers are scattered across study records and may cover different patients.
analysis_examples.lesson: Find genuinely scarce measurements and bound the complete-case cohort before designing the study.
analysis_examples.figure: Horizontal bars of the case count for each measured layer in the target cohort, with a dashed line at the smallest layer marking the ceiling on any analysis needing every layer at once.
